cards.b: Inner core (solid), outer core (liquid), mantle (semi-molten), crust (thin, solid).
Convection currents in the mantle, driven by heat from the core, drag the plates slowly.
Plates move apart; magma rises to make new crust. Forms mid-ocean ridges and shield volcanoes.
Denser oceanic plate subducts beneath continental plate. Forms trenches, fold mountains, composite volcanoes.
Plates collide and crumple, forming fold mountains such as the Himalayas. No volcanoes.
Plates slide past each other. Strong earthquakes, no volcanoes. Example: San Andreas Fault.
A denser plate sinks beneath another at a convergent boundary, melting to form magma.
Focus: where the earthquake starts underground. Epicentre: point on the surface directly above.
Steep cone of ash and sticky lava layers; violent eruptions; at subduction zones. Example: Mount Fuji.
Wide, gentle slopes built by runny lava; gentle eruptions; at divergent boundaries and hot spots. Example: Mauna Loa.
Horseshoe of plate boundaries around the Pacific with about 75% of active volcanoes and 90% of earthquakes.
Richter (moment magnitude) measures energy released. Mercalli measures intensity or damage, I to XII.
Primary: direct damage from shaking or eruption. Secondary: later effects like tsunamis, fires, disease.
A fast, extremely hot cloud of ash, gas and rock that rushes down a volcano's slope.
Fertile soil, geothermal energy, tourism, jobs, minerals, low chance of eruption in a lifetime, cannot afford to move.

short.q: Explain why volcanoes form at oceanic-continental convergent boundaries.
short.model: The denser oceanic plate sinks into the mantle and melts to form magma. This magma is less dense, so it rises through the crust and erupts.

short.q: Explain why earthquakes happen at conservative boundaries.
short.model: Plates sliding past each other get stuck by friction and pressure builds. When they suddenly slip, the energy is released as an earthquake.
points: sudden release of energy as seismic waves

short.q: Explain why earthquakes cause more deaths in LICs than in HICs.
short.model: LICs often have poorly built houses that collapse and few emergency services. HICs have strict building codes, drills and fast rescue.
points: weaker emergency response/less preparation in LICs

short.q: Explain why volcanic eruptions can be predicted better than earthquakes.
short.model: Volcanoes give warning signs such as small tremors, gas release and ground swelling, which can be monitored. Earthquakes have no reliable warning signs.
points: monitoring signs for volcanoes (tremors, gas, tilt)

short.q: Give two benefits of living near an active volcano.
short.model: Volcanic soils are very fertile, giving good harvests. Geothermal energy and tourism provide power and jobs.
